inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim: bank borrowings 2,065 + convertible note 437 = 2,502 debt (company's own 'total bank borrowings and other debts'); against cash and equivalents 1,290 + bank deposits >3 months 499 + pledged bank deposits 1,663 + restricted deposit 26 = 3,478 (company's own liquidity figure, MD&A section 3). Net cash 976. The pledged deposits secure the bank borrowings in a back-to-back structure, so both legs are counted. Lease liabilities (43) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). FVTPL investments and loan receivables sit in equity_bridge, not here.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free; mature-market ERP 4.5% plus ~1.5pp China country risk; beta ~1.1 for a small-cap HK-listed games publisher; plus ~1pp for governance/treasury risk (ETH holdings, Fuzhou property, 27%-NCI loss-making listed sub) gives a cost of equity ~10%. Debt (HIBOR+2.2%, ~5.5%) is back-to-back against pledged deposits and is a small weight, so WACC rounds to 10%. The same 10% is used in all three scenarios: cyclicality and the aging-IP risk are charged in the bear flows and weights, not again in the discount rate. SANITY FIX PASS (2026-10-11): sanity_check tripped on implied P/E (66.8x vs 19.6x 10-yr average) with diagnosis candidate wacc_too_low; per the Step 8c.5 template an extreme-cyclicality premium (+1.0pp; adjusted EBITDA ranged 226 -> 1,793 -> 722, more than 3x peak-to-trough) was added, taking WACC to 11% in ALL scenarios (the spread between scenarios stays zero, so risk is still charged once in the discount rate and the bear path carries the operating downside).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease principal (FY2025 60) plus lease interest (~3) deducted inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path 1.2% of revenue; lease liabilities (29 current + 14 non-current at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (H1 FY2026 total D&A 184 less ROU depreciation 28 = 156, 7.5% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Mynd.ai Group is 73.19% owned (26.81% NCI, FY2025 note 'Non-wholly owned subsidiaries'). Mynd.ai carries a deficit equity (RMB -20m FY2025) so group NCI book is NEGATIVE (-45 FY2025, -102 H1 FY2026): nothing is deducted in the bridge. Flows are modelled 100% consolidated, so they carry all of Mynd.ai's losses including the ~27% share that accrues to NCI (RMB114m of the FY2025 loss). That overcharges the house basis by roughly RMB0.1-0.2/share while Mynd.ai loses money and vanishes as it approaches breakeven; left in as deliberate conservatism.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' + adaptations a/b/c/d). NetDragon is an operating company (games + education hardware), not a holdco, so the owner-FCF engine applies; it is a DECLINING-revenue business (revenue -43% FY2022->FY2025), so the base case starts with revenue contraction and the terminal cap is 12x, not 20x. EBITDA NORMALISATION: reported FY2025 EBITDA 722 (16.1%) is after RMB221m redundancy payments, an ETH impairment (92 in H1, more at year-end), a 59 intangible impairment and FVTPL fair-value moves; core segmental profit (gaming 897, Mynd.ai -358) less ~RMB120m/yr unallocated corporate cost plus D&A 442 gives a normalised pre-SBC EBITDA of ~RMB950-1,000m (21-22%). H1 FY2026 operating profit 144 + 130 ETH impairment + 184 D&A = 458 on 2,090 revenue = 21.9%. Base year-1 margin set at 21.5% pre-SBC. OWNER FCF BASE: last_fcf -225 is the strict FY2025 owner FCF (reported -146 less SBC 23 less interest income 56); it contains the RMB305m ETH purchase booked in 'purchase of intangible assets', the 221 redundancy cash and a ~300 working-capital drain. Ex-ETH, ex-redundancy it is roughly +300 (6-7% of revenue); the forecast is built from components, not from last_fcf. CAPEX ex-crypto: FY2025 PPE 145 + intangibles 379-305 = 219 (4.9%); H1 FY2026 92 (4.4%). INTEREST INCOME STRIPPED (56; H1 FY2026 42) because the cash pile is in the bridge; the matching assets (deposits, FVTPL, loan receivables) are all in net_debt or equity_bridge. BUYBACKS: 55 in FY2025, nil in H1 FY2026; the flat count is largely a modelling convention, but the HKD600m 12-month dividend/buyback commitment (HKD1.00/share paid for FY2025 and HKD0.50 interim for FY2026) shows the cash does reach shareholders. CRYPTO: ~12,000 ETH held as intangible assets, impaired 92 (H1 FY2025) and 130 (H1 FY2026); carrying value not separately disclosed and is EXCLUDED from the bridge (unquantified upside, and a treasury-risk flag). Fuzhou properties for sale/under development (334) and associates (97) also excluded. SBC-light market: SBC 0.5% of revenue, so the house/street band is narrow but non-zero.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year average revenue growth (-6% FY2026 recovering to +2%); every historical CAGR is negative and is a description of the FY2022-25 contraction, not a forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR -4.4% vs revenue -6.1% vs EPS -30.1%: EPS has fallen far faster than revenue or book (margin compression, redundancy costs, ETH impairments); equity has been held up by the balance sheet while payouts (RMB487m dividends FY2025) exceed earnings.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 948, FY2021 538, FY2022 726, FY2023 327, FY2024 196, FY2025 -225. A CAGR to a negative end value is undefined; the FY2025 figure carries a RMB305m ETH purchase and RMB221m redundancy cash. Ex those, FY2025 owner FCF was ~+300, still a ~70% fall from FY2022: the decline in cash generation has outpaced the revenue decline because Mynd.ai swung to a RMB358m core loss.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026: H1 revenue -12.2% YoY (2,090 vs 2,381) but +0% HoH vs H2 FY2025 (2,094); a flat H2 gives FY2026 ~4,200 = -6%. FY2027 -2% as Mynd.ai hardware keeps shrinking against a stabilised gaming line; flat FY2028 then +1-2% from SaaS mix and evergreen-IP monetisation. Terminal 2%: below China nominal GDP, for a portfolio of 15-20-year-old IPs.
base.margin_rationale: 21.5% is the H1 FY2026 ex-ETH-impairment run rate (21.9%) less a seasonal haircut; rises 2pp over five years as Mynd.ai's core loss (RMB358m FY2025, -35% YoY in H1 FY2026) halves. Gaming core margin (27% FY2025) assumed flat, not expanding. SANITY FIX PASS (2026-10-11): years 1-3 lowered 1pp (20.5/21.0/21.5) to carry ~RMB40m/yr of recurring restructuring cash: redundancy payments were RMB110m in FY2024 and RMB221m in FY2025, so 'one-off' is not the right word for them.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax FY2025 200 on ~530 normalised EBIT = 38%; H1 FY2026 129 on ~274 = 47%. Gaming profits are taxed in the PRC (15% high-tech rate plus dividend withholding) while Mynd.ai's US/UK losses are unrelieved. Ramps to 25% as Mynd.ai losses narrow and the group EBIT base widens.
base.da_capex_rationale: D&A ex-ROU 7.5% of revenue (H1 FY2026) converges on capex ex-crypto (4.4-4.9%) at ~5.5% by year 6: the excess depreciation on the Fuzhou campus and old capitalised development runs off.
base.wc_rationale: Contract liabilities are ~10% of revenue and Mynd.ai carries receivables/inventory; 15% capture on the revenue CHANGE means contraction years consume cash (RMB-40m in FY2026) and growth years release a little. FY2025's ~RMB300m working-capital drain was dominated by the restructuring and the Mynd.ai inventory unwind, not repeated.

bull.rationale: Mynd.ai reaches breakeven by FY2029 (its core loss has halved in 18 months), gaming grows low-single-digit on AI-cut development cost with the Eudemons MAU trend holding, and moyu AI / education AIGC add a few points of growth from FY2028. Group margin reaches 27% (gaming 27% core margin on ~75% of revenue plus a breakeven Mynd.ai, less corporate cost). Cap 14x.

bear.rationale: The FY2022-25 decline continues at a slowing rate: evergreen-IP engagement decays (Conquer's MENA base, Eudemons ageing), Mynd.ai never reaches breakeven as Chinese low-cost panels take share, the PRC tax wedge stays high because losses remain unrelieved, and redundancy-type charges recur. Zero terminal growth, 10x cap. Working-capital release from contraction partly offsets. This path is the one the HKD600m payout commitment would have to be funded from the balance sheet under.

scenario_narratives.base: Revenue contracts a further 6% in FY2026 and 2% in FY2027 then flattens; the gaming line has already stabilised half-on-half (+3.1% HoH in H1 FY2026) while Mynd.ai hardware keeps shrinking. The FY2025 cost programme (opex -22%, RMB221m redundancy cash) is fully in the FY2026 run rate, so the normalised pre-SBC EBITDA margin holds ~21.5% and edges to 23.5% as Mynd.ai's loss halves. The cash tax wedge (PRC tax on gaming, unrelieved Mynd.ai losses) ramps down from 42% to 25%. Owner FCF runs ~RMB350-450m, 8-10% of revenue, below the ~RMB510m/yr (HKD600m) payout commitment, so the RMB1.9bn bridge is partly distributed rather than reinvested.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gaming returns to low-single-digit growth as AI cuts development cost and the Eudemons/Conquer communities keep monetising; Mynd.ai reaches breakeven by FY2029 on SaaS mix and the AI-employee cost base; moyu AI and government education-AI contracts (Thailand, Cameroon, Volcengine) add a few points of growth from FY2028. Margin reaches 27% and cash tax normalises at 25% as the loss drag disappears.
scenario_narratives.bear: The FY2022-25 revenue decline continues at a decelerating pace through the whole decade: 15-20-year-old IPs lose engagement, no replacement title ships, Mynd.ai stays loss-making in a commoditised panel market, redundancy charges recur and the cash tax rate stays above 35%. Owner FCF falls from ~RMB280m toward ~RMB150m and the terminal value is capped at 10x on zero growth. The shareholder-return commitment is then funded from the deposits and the ETH holdings become the swing asset.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: revenue has fallen 43% in three years with no new-IP pipeline, operating cash flow was negative in three of the last five half-years, management holds ETH on the balance sheet (two impairments in 18 months) and the loss-making listed sub has deficit equity. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things (Mynd.ai breakeven, gaming growth, AI monetisation) to come true together. Base 50%: the gaming line has stabilised half-on-half and the cost programme is real.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A cheap stock on a shrinking business: at the current price the market capitalisation (~RMB3.6bn) is about half covered by net cash, deposits and liquid investments (~RMB1.9bn after haircuts), and the remaining ~RMB1.7bn of enterprise value is ~2x normalised EBITDA. The house model values the cash because the company demonstrably pays it out (HKD1.00/share FY2025, HKD600m committed for the next twelve months) and values the business on contraction-first drivers with a 12x terminal cap. The value is therefore in the bridge and the first five years of flows, not the terminal: the thesis is 'the decline slows and the cash reaches shareholders', not growth. SANITY CHECK: the multiples check tripped on implied P/E because FY2025 EPS (RMB0.286) is a trough carrying ~RMB0.6-0.8/share of redundancy, ETH-impairment and intangible-impairment charges; on normalised EPS (~RMB0.9-1.0) the weighted IV is ~13-14x. EV/EBITDA, P/B and P/S all sat within their 10-year bands. One fix pass was applied (WACC 10% -> 11% cyclicality premium, base margin -1pp in years 1-3); the P/E rule remains outside its band because the denominator is the trough year, not because the model assumes a re-rating: the base terminal value is 12x year-10 FCF, which is ~6x year-10 EBITDA, inside the stock's own FY2020-24 range of 5-6x.
key_risks_to_valuation: The revenue decline does not decelerate: every -5pp on FY2026-28 growth is roughly RMB-1/share
ETH treasury: ~12,000 ETH held as intangibles, impaired RMB92m and RMB130m in consecutive first halves; excluded from the bridge but a signal that capital allocation is not purely shareholder-driven
Cash tax wedge: PRC tax on gaming profit with Mynd.ai losses unrelieved; if Mynd.ai never reaches breakeven the 25% terminal rate is too low
Working-capital seasonality: H1 operating cash flow has been negative three years running; the model assumes the FY2025 RMB300m drain was restructuring-related and does not repeat
Back-to-back financing: RMB2.1bn of bank borrowings secured by RMB1.7bn of pledged deposits; net cash is real but gross leverage limits flexibility if the RMB/HKD spread trade unwinds
Illiquid FVTPL (unlisted funds with crypto exposure, unlisted equity that jumped 29->216 in one half) haircut 50% but still RMB217m of bridge value
Currency: RMB flows against an HKD quote; the CNY/HKD rate is dated 2026-10-10 and refresh_price.py does not move it
